thread:
incident-bot: 🔔 ALERT: Dedicated pool 'acme-enterprise-1' GPU utilization 99% for 6m, queue growth detected. Autoscale not triggered (policy=conservative). Pager sent to oncall-maya
oncall-maya: ack'ing. pulling graphs now — assigning to SRE.
sre_jordan: I see sustained 95-100% GPU usage across all nodes in pool acme-enterprise-1. Job queue length +420, p95 latency for token generation spiking to 3.2s.
eng-lee: any idea why autoscaler didn't kick? policy should allow burst to shared-burst-pool.
sre_jordan: autoscale logs show "scale_check: passed" but then "scale_block: tenant_isolation=true" — looks like conservative isolation flag prevented cross-tenant burst.
oncall-maya: paging infra-devin for options to create emergency burst capacity. @infra-devin can you join?
infra-devin: on it. I can spin up 4 preemptible A10 nodes in eu-west-1; estimate ~4-6 min to warm. Would that be acceptable for ACME?
cs-anna: ACME support contact is online; they're seeing 502s / slow responses for several teams. They just asked for ETA.
product-oliver: we need to avoid broad tenant throttles if possible — prefer targetted mitigations first.
eng-lee: two quick mitigations: 1) allow pool to burst to shared-burst-pool (requires flip of tenant_isolation flag and temporary routing change), 2) selectively degrade quality (reduce max_tokens to 512 for non-critical routes) to free up KV cache. Which is faster?
sre_jordan: flipping isolation flag is a config change in control plane + route update; but rollback is easy. That might be faster than spinning nodes (depends). Degrading max_tokens can be done by pushing a dynamic routing policy to edge in ~2-3 minutes.
oncall-maya: prefer to do softer degradations first while infra brings nodes up. Can someone push a short policy to throttle non-SLA routes?
eng-lee: I can push a temporary routing policy now. Proposed policy: for tenant acme-enterprise-1, route requests with route_tag != "priority" to model-small and cap max_tokens=512 and concurrency=1.
eng-lee: code:
```json
{
  "match": "tenant==\"acme-enterprise-1\" && route_tag!~\"priority\"",
  "actions": ["route:model-small","set:max_tokens=512","set:concurrency=1"]
}
```
eng-lee: applying policy in 10s...
incident-bot: deploy-bot: policy deploy queued by eng-lee, ID=policy-3172. Starting rollout (canary 10%).
sre_jordan: rolling canary. watching queue length. Grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/acme/pool-acme-1?from=now-30m&to=now
cs-anna: ACME says some endpoints are better already. They report reduced 502 rate but still slow for some heavy batch jobs.
infra-devin: nodes requested — preemptible A10 x4 started. cloud logs show instances provisioning, ~120s to attach GPUs then 2 min to pull images.
product-oliver: timeline update for exec: initial alert at t0, policy canary at t0+3m, infra requested at t0+4m.
oncall-maya: handoff: I'll stay until the new nodes are attached and p90 latency below 700ms for 10m, then hand to day-sre.
sre_jordan: can we also evict non-critical background jobs running in the pool? There's a few big batch jobs from internal integrations.
eng-lee: making a targeted eviction: `rli jobs cancel --pool acme-enterprise-1 --label workload=background --age>60m` — will be careful to only target best-effort jobs. Executing now.
incident-bot: deploy-bot: job-cancel command executed by eng-lee, 12 jobs cancelled.
sre_jordan: queue dropped from +420 to +85 after policy + cancellations. GPU utilization falling to ~88%. Latency p95 down to 1.1s. Good progress.
infra-devin: new nodes now ready and joined pool-burst (eu-west-1). Initiating model warmup (KV priming) for acme models.
eng-lee: warmup script:
```
for m in acme-*; do rli model warmup --model $m --tokens 2000 & done
```
eng-lee: running. warmup should reduce cold-start tail.
cs-anna: ACME acknowledged the update and requested a short postmortem + what prevented autoscale. They want assurance this won't recur.
product-oliver: assign follow-up: root cause appears to be tenant_isolation conservative config + no auto-override for critical SLAs. Need a K-ticket for policy change + runbook update.
oncall-maya: current status: queue 48, GPU util 65-75% (stable), p95 420ms. I'll keep monitoring for the next 30m then transition. Anything else immediate?
sre_jordan: please open an incident record and tag `acme-enterprise` + link to this thread. I'll start RCA notes.
oncall-maya: opened INC-17725 in tracker. tagging teams: eng-runtime, infra, product, cs.
cs-anna: CS will draft an interim customer note: summary + ETA for RCA by EOD. Sending to ACME now.
eng-lee: planned follow-ups:
- change autoscaler to allow controlled cross-tenant burst for SLA flagged tenants (requires product signoff)
- add ability for autoscaler to override isolation for emergency with oncall approval (audit logged)
- add warmup prefetch when burst nodes are provisioned
- refine routing policy templates for emergency degrade

product-oliver: include risk/rollback plan for each change. We'll review in next triage.
oncall-maya: handing off monitoring to day-sre @sre_jordan in 25m. I'll add note to postmortem.
sre_jordan: ack. I'll capture timelines and actions in INC-17725. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
